title: Irrigation Forecast vs Actual Water Gap
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irrigation:zone
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(planned_mm) as planned_mm, sum(applied_mm) as applied_mm by zone _time
| eval gap_mm=round(planned_mm-applied_mm,1)
| where gap_mm>10
| sort - gap_mm
description: Uses Irrigation controller exports telemetry to monitor how far applied watering lagged the planned amount in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for zones that are falling short of schedule, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Irrigation controller exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly zone chart of planned versus applied water.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how far applied watering lagged the planned amount so you can spot zones that are falling short of schedule before it becomes annoying.
